summary.text: Snow Crystal Formation is an ice and snow path Gu formation that Fang Yuan's time path clone completes in Mini Northern Plains.

claims.text: The clone places the final mortal Gu and the formation activates. Its range is a few dozen square kilometers. Tens of thousands of mortal Gu from rank one to five go into it, of all paths, but most are ice and snow path. Two ice path Immortal Gu obtained from snowman Gu Immortals sit at the core. The cores also include three rank eight immortal materials, ice path crystal essences, each large like a mountain peak, ice-blue, with holes that spew cold air unceasingly.

The clone names this formation snow crystal formation. Its main purpose is to emit frost energy that constantly alters the environment. It can also monitor and control the area. He wants snowmen a place to live and grow, and wants snow monsters and snowmen to live there without fully isolating them, so they still interact and conflict. Food path methods can maintain the formation, but the three ice path crystal essences are expendable. The frost energy carves ice and snow path dao marks in the surroundings for a while before they dissipate, and does not increase the sovereign immortal aperture’s total of those dao marks. Attainment is shared with the main body, so the clone is a formation path grandmaster. A great grandmaster could use the three ice path crystal essences directly and would not need the ice path Immortal Gu for this formation.
After the snowman relocation is completed, the time path clone controls the formation and watches snow monsters emerge. Under its effect, a snow monster production line starts to work.
